title: 25岁营销人辞职创业：只要做热爱的事，多少钱都能活
carouselChartTitle: 25岁营销人辞职创业：只要做热爱的事，多少钱都能活
author: 阿星
content:
**6个月runway，他说：我可以活在任何金额，只要做热爱的事**

25岁的Alex Liu六月quit job，100% focus on new product **AutoAE**。七月launch，现在$400 MRR，six months runway left。

Pressure's on。

## 二、

几年前college break赚first dollar online。Want travel、lacked funds。Some market research experience，started selling in-depth analyses of industries、companies on local Fiverr-like platform。First month赚over $2k。

Big moment。Suddenly realized working for others not only path。

## 三、

Since then，built few side projects while working full time。But all ended with "not enough success"。

When has job，tends get deeply involved、aim excel，leads conflicting priorities、ultimately poor performance both areas。

That，along with previous employer's discouragement of side projects，meant no interest splitting focus。So quit job two months ago，now focusing entirely on AutoAE。

Happy with decision because，"Timing crucial in world of marketing。" Needs be prepared seize every opportunity，even if means living on minimal savings。

"**可以活在任何金额，只要做热爱的事。**"

## 四、

有趣的是，cofounder not working on AutoAE full time，但still 50-50 equity split。Some partnerships could cause issues，but not this one。

Important be equally incentivized。Anyway，time investments not dictated by whether have full-time jobs。Partner works just as hard。

"With shared belief，money issues become less significant。"

## 五、

AutoAE七月launch。Describe as bridge between CapCut和Adobe After Effects。Allows create viral hooks for videos in seconds。

Offer free tier、one-time purchase（$2.90 per video）、subscription tiers（$8.30/mo）。

Revenue：$400 MRR
Funding：$1k from personal savings
Founder pay：$0（hit roughly $1k MRR时take 20%）
Business bank account：$1480.27
Personal bank account：Six months runway

First customers cold outreach——mostly "super cold"，also few YouTuber friends。Everything earn reinvested into marketing。

## 六、

View every single business decision needs be analyzed。

"Calculate profits和losses for every product decision——at least roughly。"

Even something small如purchasing SaaS subscription，calculates ROI。When possible，borrows access to friend's account instead。

So monthly business expenses low——pretty much non-existent：
- Vercel - Website Hosting: $0
- Supabase - Database / Auth: $0
- CloudFlare R2 - Storage / CDN: $0
- Self Hosting - Video Rendering: $0
- Video editing: $0（contractor working for free because believes in product）

月个人支出——also very low：
- Rent: $200
- Food: $250
- SaaS subscriptions: $50
- Car payment: $300

## 七、

Raised in "average middle-class East Asian family"，parents placed huge emphasis on saving money。

"Even now，mom still reminds on every call，'You must save some money。' LOL，Asian moms。Never really followed advice。"

Despite mother's frequent reminders save，went another route。Prefers investing in business、living life with purpose rather than strictly adhering to traditional saving methods。

Focus being happy，while being disciplined。Working out——saved up over 6 months runway，after all。

## 八、

Every Sunday，makes list of key tasks upcoming week、prioritizes。

List not as detailed now as when had job。Better focus on fewer tasks as founder。Allows more flexibility、gives ability seize unexpected opportunities。

Also divides money into three parts：
- **Spending**：Stays in safe savings account
- **Risk taking**：Goes into marketing、tracks ROI
- **Emergencies**：Currently form of car，can sell in emergency

## 九、

Currently not making financial investments outside business——that's where wants focus。

Hasn't made decision willy nilly；calculated opportunity cost、decided at this stage of life，time most valuable asset。

Once 28 years old，thinks will change、start investing in stocks或其他financial instruments——but only areas thoroughly understands。

Meanwhile，does make one other kind investment。Buys clothes for girlfriend。

"Investment in good life。She is muse。"

## 十、

No issue seeking external funding。Heck，wants be angel investor one day self。But says **irresponsible raise funds before achieving at least $1k MRR。**

That milestone indicator of product-market fit。Raising或borrowing money before reaching often carries higher cost than anticipated。

## 十一、

Advice：Don't just build in public。Market product beyond X。

Write posts for Reddit、Medium、IH。Create images for Pinterest和Instagram。Make videos for YouTube和TikTok。

"You are both maker和seller。Try innovative ways market product——will work！"

## 写在最后

Alex的故事是关于commitment——

25岁，quit job，$400 MRR，6个月runway。

His philosophy？**"I can live on any amount as long as I'm doing what I love。"**

Key insights——

- Low burn rate（$800 total monthly expenses）
- Cofounder equity split 50-50 even if not full-time
- Reinvest everything
- Time > Money right now
- Market beyond X（Reddit、Medium、Pinterest、YouTube、TikTok）

最重要的是，**he's willing to live on almost nothing for what he loves。**

That's the definition of passion。

*原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写*
